lines.text: Spike退火：到达峰值后立即降温
lines.zh: Spike退火：到达峰值后立即降温
lines.en: Spike annealing: cool immediately after reaching the peak

lines.text: 高激活与低扩散之间的尖锐窗口
lines.zh: 高激活与低扩散之间的尖锐窗口
lines.en: A narrow window between high activation and low diffusion

lines.text: Spike是温度轨迹，不是独立热源；通常由RTP平台实现。
lines.zh: Spike是温度轨迹，不是独立热源；通常由RTP平台实现。
lines.en: Spike describes a temperature trajectory, not a separate heat source; it is usually implemented on an RTP platform.
Still contributes to the thermal budget
Affects the driving forces and process window

lines.text: 掺杂激活与扩散的耦合平衡
lines.zh: 掺杂激活与扩散的耦合平衡
lines.en: Coupled balance of dopant activation and diffusion
• Almost zero dwell near the peak
Still contributes to the thermal budget

lines.text: 确保工艺气氛与压力稳定
lines.zh: 确保工艺气氛与压力稳定
lines.en: Ensure stable process ambient and pressure

lines.text: 受控升溫，减少驻留累积
lines.zh: 受控升温，减少驻留累积

lines.text: 精准到达目标嶂值附近
lines.zh: 精准到达目标峰值附近
lines.en: Precisely reach the vicinity of the target peak

lines.text: 峰值附近不做额外停留
lines.zh: 峰值附近不做额外停留
lines.en: No additional hold near the peak

lines.text: 迅速冷却并开展计量验证
lines.zh: 迅速冷却并开展计量验证
lines.en: Cool rapidly and perform metrology validation
The thermal budget and defect generation
Risks when the balance is lost
• Too short / too low: insufficient activation,
• Too high / local hot spots: increased diffusion,

lines.text: 漏电上升、材料或界面损伤
lines.zh: 漏电上升、材料或界面损伤
lines.en: Higher leakage and material or interface damage

lines.text: 目标：在可行窗口内取得更好平衡
lines.zh: 目标：在可行窗口内取得更好平衡
lines.en: Goal: a better balance within the feasible window

lines.text: 量測应：Rs/ Hall• SIMS / SRP•TEM• 结漏电 /WAT
lines.zh: 量测反馈：Rs / Hall · SIMS / SRP · TEM · 结漏电 / WAT
lines.en: Metrology feedback: Rs / Hall · SIMS / SRP · TEM · junction leakage / WAT

lines.text: 总灣杂分布与扩散形貌
lines.zh: 总掺杂分布与扩散形貌
lines.en: Total dopant distribution and diffusion morphology

lines.text: 反懷用于收敏 Peak 与 Quench 窗口
lines.en: Feedback narrows the Peak and Quench windows

lines.text: 对下游性能的主要影响
lines.zh: 对下游性能的主要影响

lines.en: Thermal treatment of some HKMG interfaces

lines.text: “零驻留”是工程近似；升温和冷却过程仍会贡献总热预算。
lines.zh: “零驻留”是工程近似；升温和冷却过程仍会贡献总热预算。
lines.en: “Zero dwell” is an engineering approximation; heating and cooling still contribute to the total thermal budget.
